---
title: "Verification"
---

## 23 November 2026

- Connect IQ SDK 9.3.0 built the Venu 4 45 mm app and exported 29 profiles covering 33 compiler variants. Type checking passed with warnings enabled, and launcher icons matched the profiles.
- Six receiver integration tests passed, covering authentication, retries, restart recovery, conflicting chunks, size limits, and invalid audio.
- Windows builds passed with and without private settings. The signing key carried over, and packaging rejected private settings and unknown device IDs.
- Bash syntax passed. Native Unix builds, simulator audio, and a live HTTPS deployment were outside this run.

## Before release

- On a watch, record, stop, play, and delete using buttons and touch. Check saved notes after restart, partial notes after interruption or full storage, and speaker and headphone playback.
- Test automatic upload after reconnecting with the app open and closed. Interrupt an upload, retry, and compare the receiver checksum.
- Disable automatic upload and verify manual upload still works.
- For phone sync, complete the [Android beta hardware checks](android-beta.qmd#physical-device-acceptance).
